title: LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It
abstract: arXiv:2608.31016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. translated_title: LLM判官验证存在而非缺失：AI临床笔记中的遗漏盲区及其修复方法
translated_abstract: 环境式AI记录员（ambient AI scribes）负责起草临床笔记，已发表的审计发现其主要错误是遗漏：即就诊过程中已确立、但笔记未能记录的信息。标准的检查方法是使用LLM判官：由第二个模型对照就诊转录文稿阅读笔记并标记问题。我们探究的问题是：判官能否检测出遗漏？公开语料库无法提供标准答案，因为其临床医生参考笔记与转录文稿存在实质性差异。我们的基准包含500对单错误笔记对，来源于经审计的事实清单，其中298对存在确定缺失的具名事实，202对为添加或篡改的对照组。在八种判官设计中，成对判别能力（缺陷笔记得分低于其干净孪生笔记，0.5等同于抛硬币）在添加或篡改内容上达到0.79-0.94，而在遗漏上仅为0.50-0.63。在单篇笔记上，没有任何设计标记遗漏的频率能可靠地高于完美笔记。措辞变化、投票机制和GEPA提示词优化只能移动工作点，而无法产生可用的……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了包含500对单错误临床笔记的基准测试，发现LLM判官能可靠识别笔记中被添加或篡改的内容（判别力0.79-0.94），但对遗漏错误几乎完全失明（判别力仅0.50-0.63），揭示了LLM验证只能确认“存在”而无法确认“缺失”的根本性盲区，且措辞调整、投票和提示词优化等简单方法均无法修复此问题。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that LLM judges reliably detect added or altered content in AI-drafted clinical notes (0.79-0.94 paired discrimination) but are essentially blind to omissions (0.50-0.63), and simple interventions like rewording, voting, and GEPA prompt optimization fail to create usable omission detection.
